dialogue_turns.text: [bright, to the camera] When do you leave a game?
[to the camera, at once, flat] Eighty-five minutes. Beat the crowd.
[turning to him, accusing] He's missed four winning goals.
[to the camera, flat] And not one train.

payload.scene: A phone vlog from high in the open stand of a full American football stadium in late afternoon sun. A big crowd all round.
payload.sample_context: A ten-second comedy moment played by two close friends on a sports trip. It must sound like two real people talking, quick and natural, never like an advert or a narrator. LUNA, about 25, is cheerful, quick and sure of herself; to her everything is good news. TIMO, about 30, is slow, dry and proud; he never raises his voice. They answer each other fast.

text: When do you leave the game? 85 minutes, beat the crowd. He's missed four winning goals. And not one train.
